title_card.kicker: Broad Sky Partners · Portfolio Resource Group
title_card.headline: What if every portfolio company ran on the same intelligence?

narration: Tyler, this is a working system, not a deck. Six platforms, one portal, and every datapoint tied to an action.

action_args.text: Show me how to take Punctual Pros nationwide

narration: Ask it the question you would ask an associate. It answers from verified data: filings, deed records, add-on screens, and the Smith and Howard template you already proved.

title_card.headline: From Lancaster to national, in four phases.

narration: Densify the core, tuck in franchisees across four states, build the Mid-Atlantic platform, then consolidate inside the Authority Brands network.
Seventy-seven thousand home sales, rendered live. Every bar is a household that just inherited a furnace it has never met.
The expansion arcs are the add-on screen on a map: sixty-one targets, scored and sourced.
Live National Weather Service alerts become a staffing plan: how many technicians, which hub, which day.
A voice agent answers every call in two rings, books into dispatch, and works outbound on renewals. Unanswered calls stop being lost revenue.
Cheap connected-TV flights that switch on with storm alerts, Local Services Ads for intent, and new-mover postcards from the deed feed, all with sourced costs.
For CET, one hundred eighty-three treatment plants ranked by fit, with funded projects, so Horton knows who to call on Monday.
Each platform gets an operating system: the integration spine for every tuck-in, and the story a buyer pays a tech-enabled multiple for.
One hundred fifty-seven add-on targets, thirty-five competing sponsors, and public-comp benchmarks, in one acquisition engine.
Six website concepts, each with its own assistant, show what every company looks like when it is built to convert.

title_card.kicker: Syed Rahman · for the Portfolio Resource Group
title_card.headline: Let's put this to work inside the portfolio.

narration: I built this to show how I would work inside the PRG. I would like to put it to work with you.
